items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And that's the last I saw him was in the Apollo Theater and he told me to come on the other side of the stage, he wanted me to hear this organ because he knew I liked the organ, you know.

ctx.x: You see. And he'd never ask you to have a taste. He never asked you to have any of his food. And he'd laugh and talk, he'd laugh. Talking about him, oh, he was such a lovable guy. And that's the last I saw him was in the Apollo Theater and he told me to come on the other side of the stage, he wanted me to hear this organ because he knew I liked the organ, you know.
Right, that's right, you played the organ, too.
